next_step: Run full-scale vector ingest POC on 100M docs, validate top-k latency + reranker throughput
notes:
Account summary: SableVector Labs building an enterprise search product for law firms. Heavy RAG focus: embeddings store + ANN for candidate retrieval, then cross-encoder reranker for top-10. Wants predictable latency for client-facing search -- target 80ms median end-to-end for 10k qps internal tests; willing to trade recall for latency in some lanes.

Initial ask / pain:
- Current stack: in-house pgvector + Redis cache; scaling to 100M+ vectors spikes CPU and causes 2-3x latency variability.
- They ran a small test with Pinecone but saw cost blowout at scale. Interested in hybrid: cheap ANN (HNSW) for recall + Redwood-hosted reranker fallback to a smaller cross-encoder.

Technical requirements called out on call (Dec 18):
- Real-time connector to vector DBs (pgvector, Weaviate, Pinecone) with upsert streaming semantics and idempotency.
- Namespace/tenant isolation for multi-law-firm deployment.
- Vector metadata filtering + boolean attribute pushdown for narrow queries.
- Support for dense + sparse fusion / hybrid retrieval.
- Bulk ingestion performance: need to ingest 50M vectors in <48h for baseline.
- Hot-cold tiering: cold vectors on object store, warm in ANN index.
- Reranker throughput target: 800-1200 QPS on a single dedicated pool for re-ranking top-10.

Security / compliance notes:
- Must integrate with their Okta SSO (SAML).
- Enterprise requires KMS integration and per-tenant audit logs.
- Data residency: primary US-only; potential EU tenancy for EMEA clients.

Commercial / process notes:
- Interested in Dedicated for predictable latency; will evaluate hosted API for initial POC.
- Ask for a cost model that separates retrieval (ANN) cost vs reranker compute cost to show savings vs Pinecone-only approach.
- Looking for a connector spec doc to share with their infra team. (see drive links)

Quotes / call snippets: "If we can get sub-100ms for search + rerank while keeping unit costs under $0.002/query we can replace our whole stack" — Head of Search (S. Morales).

Current sentiment: curious + skeptical on pricing. Technical confidence high after SE demo but legal needs more assurance on residency and logging.

POC scopes discussed:
- Phase 1: ingest 10M docs, baseline ANN recall + measure top-50 candidate latency.
- Phase 2: wire in Redwood reranker, measure end-to-end p95 and cost per query.
- Phase 3: scale to 100M, test hot-cold tiering and failover to cheaper model variants.
